info.title: dvx Dataverse Extensions
info.description: CLI for deploying code-first Dataverse / Power Platform artifacts — plugin assemblies and web resources.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: dvx — deploy Dataverse / Power Platform code artifacts

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: -h
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: plugin
commands.description: Deploy and register Dataverse plugin assemblies.

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Build and push the plugin package to Dataverse.

options.name: --env
options.description: Named environment from config file. Optional if defaultEnvironment is set in config or if --url / --client-id / --client-secret are provided.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to config file. Defaults to the nearest dvx.json, searched upward from the current directory (like git).

options.name: --url
options.description: Dataverse environment URL (e.g. https://org.crm.dynamics.com). Overrides the url from the config file. Env var: DVX_URL.

options.name: --client-id
options.description: Service principal client (application) ID. Overrides config. Env var: DVX_CLIENT_ID.

options.name: --client-secret
options.description: Service principal client secret. Overrides config. Env var: DVX_CLIENT_SECRET.

options.name: --project
options.description: Path to the plugin .csproj file. The tool will run 'dotnet build' to produce the .nupkg and .dll. If omitted, falls back to the 'project' field in config, then a single .csproj in the current directory.

options.name: --publisher-prefix
options.description: Dataverse publisher customization prefix (e.g. 'solu'). Required for package deployment. If omitted, falls back to publisherPrefix in config.

options.name: --solution-unique-name
options.description: Unique name of the Dataverse solution to add deployed components (plugin steps / web resources) to. Falls back to solutionUniqueName in config.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose/debug logging.

commands.name: webresource
commands.description: Deploy and publish Dataverse web resources.

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Upsert and publish Dataverse web resources from a folder and/or a manifest file.

options.name: --env
options.description: Named environment from config file. Optional if defaultEnvironment is set in config or if --url / --client-id / --client-secret are provided.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to config file. Defaults to the nearest dvx.json, searched upward from the current directory (like git).

options.name: --url
options.description: Dataverse environment URL (e.g. https://org.crm.dynamics.com). Overrides the url from the config file. Env var: DVX_URL.

options.name: --client-id
options.description: Service principal client (application) ID. Overrides config. Env var: DVX_CLIENT_ID.

options.name: --client-secret
options.description: Service principal client secret. Overrides config. Env var: DVX_CLIENT_SECRET.

options.name: --folder
options.description: Folder to auto-upsert web resources from, recursively. Each file's Dataverse name is derived as {prefix}_/{relativePath}. Falls back to webResources.folder in config.

options.name: --manifest
options.description: Path to a web resource manifest JSON (array of { dataverseName, localPath, displayName, type }). Falls back to webResources.manifest in config.

options.name: --publisher-prefix
options.description: Dataverse publisher customization prefix (e.g. 'solu'). Required for package deployment. If omitted, falls back to publisherPrefix in config.

options.name: --solution-unique-name
options.description: Unique name of the Dataverse solution to add deployed components (plugin steps / web resources) to. Falls back to solutionUniqueName in config.

options.name: --no-publish
options.description: Skip publishing web resources after upsert.

options.name: --delete-orphaned
options.description: Delete web resources that are in the target solution but not in the folder/manifest. Requires a solution. Destructive — run with --dry-run first.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would happen without making any changes to Dataverse.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose/debug logging.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a template dvx.json configuration file.

options.name: --location
options.description: Directory to create dvx.json in. Defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Overwrite dvx.json if it already exists.
